introHtml: Direct to film printing allows for vibrant, detailed designs on soft fabrics, making it ideal for baby and toddler apparel. Unlike traditional screen printing, DTF transfers work well on polyester blends and dark colors without adding stiffness. Perfect for custom onesies, bibs, or t-shirts for company picnics, employee baby showers, or promotional giveaways. The durable prints hold up to frequent washing, which matters when little ones are involved.
